formats.key: launchPool((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,uint160 sqrtPriceX96,address main,address recipient,int24 tickLower,int24 tickUpper,uint128 liquidity,address owner,(uint64 buybackShareWad,uint64 burnShareWad,uint64 compoundShareWad,uint64 potCompoundShareWad,uint64 potBurnShareWad,bool publicHarvest,address secondaryRecipient,address mainRecipient,uint256 minMain,uint256 minSecondary) config)
effects: Creates the pool at sqrtPriceX96 and makes the signer the pot admin.
Fixes the pot's main and secondary sides and the delivery target for bought main (address(0) means burn).
Creates the LP program: owner (also first operator) gets the right to withdraw the liquidity. owner=0 locks the liquidity forever.
Pulls the ERC20 side(s) of the seed liquidity from the signer's allowance to the hook, at the exact amount the position needs.
Takes native currency up to msg.value for a native currency0 side and refunds the unused excess.
Sets the fee split rules: shares, fee recipients and auto-harvest minimums.
formats.shown: Launch <token0>/<token1> pool, with pool parameters, main asset, delivery, raw ticks and liquidity units, owner, every split share and recipient, raw minimums and the max native sent.

findings.title: launchPool intent never says the signer deposits both tokens into a position owned by `owner`
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity._mint pulls ERC20 legs from the caller (tstore PAYER_SLOT caller()) and the native leg from msg.value. The descriptor's intent is 'Launch GlueHook pool' / 'Launch {key.currency0}/{key.currency1} pool'.
findings.fix: Use an interpolatedIntent such as 'Launch {key.currency0}/{key.currency1} pool and deposit liquidity owned by {owner}'.

findings.title: launchPool shows no amount or bound for the ERC20 deposit, only raw liquidity units
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity._mint: ERC20 legs are settled 'at the EXACT amount owed', which is computed from liquidity, sqrtPriceX96 and ticks. The field is 'Liquidity units' (raw). The function has no max-amount parameter.
findings.fix: No descriptor change can show it. The contract would need maxAmount0/maxAmount1 parameters.

findings.title: launchPool shows native currency0 as the zero address in fields and intent
findings.evidence: Case 0 screen: 'Token 0' = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, and the intent reads 'Launch 0x0000.../TOKEN pool'. V4 keys native as address(0) (GlueHook ETH_ADDRESS).
findings.fix: Map address(0) to the native currency name (for example through a local address name), or add a label hint '(0=native)'.

findings.title: launchPool shows the disabled minSecondary as a 78-digit number, and minMain as 'off TOKEN'
findings.evidence: Case 0: 'Min 2nd (max=off)' = 115792089237316195423570985008687907853269984665640564039457584007913129639935, and 'Min main' = 'off TOKEN'. The descriptor uses raw for config.minSecondary.
findings.fix: Keep the max=off wording consistent. Hide the raw sentinel, or move the meaning into the label.

findings.title: launchPool initial price is shown as raw sqrtPriceX96, which sets the deposit ratio
findings.evidence: The descriptor field sqrtPriceX96 is 'Price sqrtX96' (raw, optional). Case 0 shows 79228162514264337593543950336.
findings.fix: No ERC-7730 format can turn a Q64.96 square-root price into a readable price.

findings.title: launchPool owner=0 locks the signer's deposit forever, explained only by a terse label
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity.createProgram sets g.owner = owner. With owner=0, _ownedProgram can never pass, so removeProgramLiquidity is impossible. Label: 'Owner (0=lock+public)'.
findings.fix: Use a clearer label, for example 'Owner (0x0 = liquidity locked forever)'.

formats.key: initPot((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,address main,address recipient)
effects: One-shot, admin only: sets the pot's main and secondary currencies and the delivery target for bought main (address(0) means burn).
Seeds the reference tick and asks GlueStick to create the main's wrapper. Nothing moves from the signer.
formats.shown: Open pot, main <main>, with the pool currencies, fee, tick spacing and the delivery target (0=burn).

findings.title: initPot shows the burn delivery as a bare zero address
findings.evidence: Case 1: 'Delivery (0=burn)' renders 0x000...0. GlueLiquidity.initPot: 'address(0) is stored verbatim and MEANS burn'.
findings.fix: Put the burn meaning in the interpolatedIntent, for example 'Open pot, buy {main}, deliver to {recipient} (0 = burn)'.

formats.key: addLiquidity((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,int24 tickLower,int24 tickUpper,uint128 liquidity,address owner)
effects: Pot admin only: creates the program with every share at zero, both fee recipients set to owner and auto-harvest off.
Pulls the ERC20 side(s) for `liquidity` units from the signer's allowance to the hook.
Takes native currency up to msg.value for a native currency0 side and refunds the excess.
owner (also operator) gets the right to withdraw the liquidity and to receive its fees.
formats.shown: Create LP for <token0>/<token1>, with fee, tick spacing, raw ticks, raw liquidity units, owner and the max native sent.

findings.title: addLiquidity shows no token amount or bound for the ERC20 deposit
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity._mint pulls the exact amount owed from the caller's allowance. The amount depends on the live pool price, and the only field is 'Liquidity units' (raw).
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists. Max-amount parameters in the contract would allow one.

findings.title: addLiquidity intent omits the deposit and that the position and its fees belong to owner
findings.evidence: GlueHook.addLiquidity sets secondaryRecipient: owner and mainRecipient: owner. The intent is 'Create LP for {key.currency0}/{key.currency1}'.
findings.fix: Use 'Deposit liquidity into {key.currency0}/{key.currency1} program owned by {owner}'.

findings.title: addLiquidity shows native currency0 as the zero address
findings.evidence: Case 8: 'Token 0' = 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000, and the intent reads 'Create LP for 0x0000.../TOKEN'.
findings.fix: Name address(0) as the native currency.

formats.key: addLiquidityAdvanced((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,int24 tickLower,int24 tickUpper,uint128 liquidity,address owner,(uint64 buybackShareWad,uint64 burnShareWad,uint64 compoundShareWad,uint64 potCompoundShareWad,uint64 potBurnShareWad,bool publicHarvest,address secondaryRecipient,address mainRecipient,uint256 minMain,uint256 minSecondary) config)
effects: Pot admin only: creates the program with the given split rules.
Pulls the ERC20 side(s) for `liquidity` units from the signer's allowance to the hook.
Takes native currency up to msg.value and refunds the excess.
owner (also operator) holds the withdraw right. owner=0 locks the deposit forever and makes harvest public.
Fee legs go to secondaryRecipient and mainRecipient. Buyback, burn and compound shares are carved off gross fees.
formats.shown: Create LP for <token0>/<token1>, with fee, ticks, raw liquidity units, owner, every share and recipient, raw minimums and the max native sent.

findings.title: addLiquidityAdvanced shows no token amount or bound for the ERC20 deposit
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity._mint pulls the exact amount owed from the caller's allowance. Only 'Liquidity units' (raw) is shown.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists.

findings.title: addLiquidityAdvanced intent omits the deposit and the owner, and owner=0 locks the funds forever
findings.evidence: Intent: 'Create LP for {key.currency0}/{key.currency1}'. Label 'Owner (0=lock+public)'. With owner=0, _ownedProgram reverts for everyone.
findings.fix: Use an intent such as 'Deposit liquidity into {key.currency0}/{key.currency1} program owned by {owner}'.

findings.title: addLiquidityAdvanced shows disabled minimums as 78-digit numbers and native as the zero address
findings.fix: State the max=off meaning more plainly, and name address(0) as native.

formats.key: addProgramLiquidity((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,uint128 liquidity)
effects: Owner only: first harvests pending fees through the stored split. Legs go to the stored recipients, the pot, burn and compound.
Pulls the ERC20 side(s) for `liquidity` units from the signer's allowance to the hook.
Takes native currency up to msg.value and refunds the excess.
formats.shown: Add LP to <token0>/<token1> (harvests), with raw liquidity units and the max native sent.

findings.title: addProgramLiquidity shows no token amount or bound for the ERC20 deposit
findings.evidence: GlueHook.addProgramLiquidity calls GlueLiquidity.mintLiquidity, then _mint pulls the exact amount from the caller. The amount depends on the live price. Only 'Liquidity units' (raw) is shown.
findings.fix: No descriptor fix exists.

findings.title: addProgramLiquidity harvest payouts go to stored recipients that the screen cannot show
findings.evidence: _harvestInto calls GlueLiquidity.place, which pays g.mainRecipient and g.secondaryRecipient from storage.
findings.fix: None. These are storage values.

formats.key: removeProgramLiquidity((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,uint128 liquidity,address to)
effects: Owner only: first harvests pending fees through the stored split. Fee remainders go to the stored recipients, not to `to`.
Removes `liquidity` units from the program position.
Sends the principal of both currencies to `to`. There is no minimum-out bound.
formats.shown: Remove LP from <token0>/<token1> (harvests), with raw liquidity units and 'Send remainder to' <to>.

findings.title: removeProgramLiquidity labels the principal recipient 'Send remainder to'
findings.evidence: GlueHook.removeProgramLiquidity calls _removeLiquidityV4(key, liquidity, address(this), to, ...). `to` 'Receives both principal legs'. Fee 'remainders' go to g.mainRecipient and g.secondaryRecipient. Descriptor label: 'Send remainder to'.
findings.fix: Rename the label to 'Send withdrawn tokens to' and put {to} in the interpolatedIntent.

findings.title: removeProgramLiquidity intent omits that the tokens go to `to`, which may be another address
findings.evidence: Case 4 sends to 0x2c62...b672 (a friend). The interpolatedIntent is 'Remove LP from {key.currency0}/{key.currency1} (harvests)'.
findings.fix: Use 'Remove LP from {key.currency0}/{key.currency1}, send to {to}'.

findings.title: removeProgramLiquidity has no minimum-out bound for the returned tokens
findings.evidence: _removeLiquidityV4 returns whatever deltas the pool gives. The function has no min-amount parameters.
findings.fix: None in the descriptor.

formats.key: harvest((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key)
effects: Collects the program's pending fees and splits them by the stored rules: buyback to the pot, burn, compound back into the position, remainders pushed to the stored main and secondary recipients.
The signer receives something only if the signer is a stored recipient.
formats.shown: Harvest <token0>/<token1>, with pool fee and tick spacing.

findings.title: harvest destinations and amounts come from storage and the screen cannot show them
findings.evidence: GlueHook.harvest calls _harvestInto, then GlueLiquidity.place pays g.mainRecipient and g.secondaryRecipient and burns or compounds by the stored shares.
findings.fix: None. The intent could say 'Harvest and split fees by program rules'.

formats.key: donate((address currency0,address currency1,uint24 fee,int24 tickSpacing,address hooks) key,uint256 amount)
effects: Takes `amount` of the pot's secondary currency from the signer: transferFrom of the ERC20, or msg.value (which must equal amount) for native.
The donation is irreversible. It funds automatic buybacks and there is no withdrawal path.
formats.shown: Donate to <token0>/<token1> pot, with a raw donation amount labelled 'pot 2nd token' and the native value sent.

findings.title: donate does not show which token is donated, and the amount is raw
findings.evidence: GlueHook.donate: secondary = p.secondary (storage), then _pullToken(secondary, msg.sender, ...). Cases 6/7: 'Donation (pot 2nd token, raw)' = 1000000000000000000000 / 1000000000.
findings.fix: No calldata path names the secondary, so tokenAmount cannot be used. The label already warns.

findings.title: donate cases 6 and 7 use the same pool but assume opposite secondary tokens
findings.evidence: Case 6 says 'Donate 1000 TOKEN to an ERC20 secondary pot' and case 7 says 'Donate 1000 USDC when the pot main is currency0'. Both use key TOKEN/USDC.
findings.fix: Make the case descriptions consistent with one pot configuration.

effects: Sends the signer everything booked to them as owed in `asset`, an amount read from storage.
Permissionless: sends the pool's parked main to the pot's current recipient. No signer assets move.
formats.shown: Retry parked delivery, with the raw pool id.

findings.title: flushDirect pool id is raw and hides the pool and its recipient
findings.evidence: The descriptor shows poolId 'Pool id' (raw). GlueLiquidity.flushDirect sends to p.recipient from storage.
findings.fix: None.

formats.key: setProgramConfig(bytes32 poolId,(uint64 buybackShareWad,uint64 burnShareWad,uint64 compoundShareWad,uint64 potCompoundShareWad,uint64 potBurnShareWad,bool publicHarvest,address secondaryRecipient,address mainRecipient,uint256 minMain,uint256 minSecondary) config)
effects: Operator only: replaces the split rules, which set the shares, the fee recipients for future harvests, public harvest and the auto-harvest minimums.
formats.shown: Edit LP program split, with raw pool id, every share as %, recipients and raw minimums.

findings.title: setProgramConfig shows raw pool id and raw minimums, with no token for the minimums
findings.evidence: poolId is 'Pool id' (raw). minMain and minSecondary are raw because the main and secondary tokens live in storage.
findings.fix: None.

findings.title: setProgramConfig intent does not say it can redirect future fee payouts
findings.evidence: GlueLiquidity._applyConfig writes g.secondaryRecipient and g.mainRecipient. The interpolatedIntent is 'Edit LP program split'.
findings.fix: Use 'Edit LP split; fees to {config.mainRecipient} / {config.secondaryRecipient}'.

effects: Operator only: moves the rule-editing role to newOperator. address(0) freezes the rules forever.
formats.shown: Set operator to <newOperator>, with the pool id.

effects: Admin only: changes where the pot's bought main is delivered. address(0) means burn.
formats.shown: Set delivery to <recipient>, with the pool id.

effects: Owner only: transfers the program's liquidity rights (add, remove, harvest) to newOwner. The operator role stays.
newOwner=0 locks the liquidity forever and forces harvest to be public.
formats.shown: Transfer program to <newOwner>, with the pool id.

findings.title: transferProgramOwnership to zero reads as a transfer, but permanently locks the signer's liquidity
findings.evidence: Case 13 intent: 'Transfer program to 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000'. GlueLiquidity.transferOwnership: with newOwner == 0, g.owner = 0 and publicHarvest is forced on, so removal is impossible forever.
findings.fix: Say it in the intent, for example 'Transfer program liquidity rights to {newOwner} (0 = lock forever)'.
